goal: remove-redundant-checks S6 (Spec docs/specs/remove-redundant-checks.spec.md, Technical Design S6 and threat model; U2, U3). The Review coordinator parser drops caller-side checks that a rebuild or a retained check already covers: B1 unknown-field rejection on finding evidence, evidence.violated, incomplete, pass approval and finding; B4 rework approval rejection; B5 approval kind and role self-assertion; B6 the empty-id trim; B7 the duplicate verification identity check; B11 the security-boundary revalidation and second git show, keeping the missing-boundary throw. acceptance.assertion: In tests/pi-canary-assurance-authority.test.ts and tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts, a verdict with one extra field on finding evidence, evidence.violated, an incomplete verdict, a pass approval or a finding parses and the result carries no extra field; a QA finding carrying evidence parses without evidence; an extra top-level child-verdict field still throws unknown field; a missing trigger, caller_chain or approval summary still throws its current message.

In tests/pi-canary-assurance-authority.test.ts, a rework verdict carrying an approval object parses to a rework verdict without approval; a pass approval with a wrong kind or authority_role parses to the expected kind and role; a finding id of spaces parses to a regenerated id; a non-string id and an empty approval summary still throw.

In tests/host-neutral-assurance-coordinator.test.ts, the verification packet for a rework verdict with an acceptance finding and one with a security_boundary finding equals the packet built before the change; an unknown boundary ref still throws security boundary source is invalid; verifier output with an extra field still discards the whole output and keeps every finding.
